Creators can still use its AI creative tools to enhance or edit their content. This update aligns with Snapchat’s broader efforts to improve Spotlight and shift focus back to original posts that highlight human creativity. In a clash between titans, the advantages seem easy to understand, since the bigger fighter looks like the stronger one. But size alone is not a strategy. Sugar Ray Robinson was a middleweight, not a heavyweight, and in the 1950s, A.J. Liebling said he looked “more like a loose-limbed dancer than a boxer.” Robinson’s advantage was completeness: speed, footwork, intelligence and stamina. In a famous 1951 match against Jake LaMotta, Robinson schooled the reigning, heavier middleweight champion with a 13th-round TKO. Brad Bernstein Completeness also applies to companies.
